G1_delayed_block3_scratch_consume.shape: Run E3/F012 first; consume block3 later from the Stage12 block3 scratch image already written by the compact Stage12 producer.
G1_delayed_block3_scratch_consume.max_live_q_regs: same as E3 during Stage345 block0/1/2; block3 runs after those live ranges are dead
G1_delayed_block3_scratch_consume.extra_q_stores_vs_E3: block3 final scatter stores only; Stage12 block3 scratch stores already exist in E3 producer
G1_delayed_block3_scratch_consume.notes: This is not live-all block3 fusion. It is the bounded delayed-consume fallback that keeps no raw reload and no duplicate Stage12.

G2_spill1_live_all.shape: Keep Q0..Q31 live across Stage345 block0/1/2 with exactly one q spill/restore.
G2_spill1_live_all.expected_instruction_delta_vs_E3: not emitted; register allocator feasibility fails before PMU

blocker.reason: After reserving block1+block2+block3 live-ins, Stage345 block0 would have only 8 non-future q colors, but its SSA max-live is 15. One q spill fixes global output cardinality, not block0 temporary pressure.

G3_partial_shared_prefix_controlled_reco.shape: Recompute or delay only the block3-producing part after enough earlier values are consumed.
G3_partial_shared_prefix_controlled_reco.max_live_q_regs: bounded by chosen granularity; can avoid live-all pressure
G3_partial_shared_prefix_controlled_reco.extra_arithmetic_vs_E3: at least out3 recompute path per stripe if raw/intermediate values are retained
G3_partial_shared_prefix_controlled_reco.extra_q_loads_vs_E3: depends on retained raw/intermediate source contract
G3_partial_shared_prefix_controlled_reco.extra_q_stores_vs_E3: depends on retained raw/intermediate source contract
G3_partial_shared_prefix_controlled_reco.expected_instruction_delta_vs_E3: unknown until a concrete retained-source contract is chosen
G3_partial_shared_prefix_controlled_reco.feasible_under_q0_reserved: likely, if it avoids keeping block3 live across block0
G3_partial_shared_prefix_controlled_reco.notes: Do not build ASM yet. This is the next design path if G1 scratch-consume is not enough and G2 live-all spill remains infeasible.

decision.build_g2_reason: After reserving block1+block2+block3 live-ins, Stage345 block0 would have only 8 non-future q colors, but its SSA max-live is 15. One q spill fixes global output cardinality, not block0 temporary pressure.
decision.build_g1_reason: Model is bounded: no duplicate Stage12, no raw reload, and only Stage345 block3 from the existing Stage12 block3 scratch image is added.
